name: scrumia
description: A composition of Claude Code modules to run a project: per-feature specs, tracking, an agent team, per-stack implementation practices. Every module is replaceable.

plugins.name: scrumia-core
plugins.description: The kernel: describes the project's active composition, its configuration, and the shared conventions. Does nothing on its own.

plugins.name: scrumia-rules
plugins.description: Fills no slot, like the kernel — the rules-hierarchy format itself: index, guides, decisions. Teaches modules and projects to consume, scaffold and evolve rule sections.

plugins.name: scrumia-specs
plugins.description: The specs slot — per-feature, TDD-oriented specs. A contextual file catalog instead of a single document.

plugins.name: scrumia-github-project
plugins.description: The tracker slot — issues, sub-issues, GitHub Projects columns, branches and PRs. Replaceable by an equivalent module for another tool.

plugins.name: scrumia-teams
plugins.description: The team slot — standing roles and sprint execution as dynamic workflows. Configurable: roles, models, escalation thresholds.

plugins.name: scrumia-discovery
plugins.description: The discovery slot — brainstorming and design. Produces issues and a branch carrying up-to-date specs.

plugins.name: scrumia-impl-rust
plugins.description: The implementation slot, for Rust apps — invalid states made unrepresentable, typed errors per layer, one test per invariant. Plugs in app by app.

plugins.name: scrumia-impl-solidjs
plugins.description: The implementation slot, for SolidJS apps — fine-grained reactivity without React reflexes, behaviour-first component tests. Plugs in app by app.

plugins.name: scrumia-practice-tdd
plugins.description: The practices slot — test-driven development, situated for an agent: the red-green-refactor cycle, the mock boundary, AC-to-test mapping. Reference, audit and refactor skills.

plugins.name: scrumia-practice-solid
plugins.description: The practices slot — SOLID principles, each with its application limit. Audits violations and over-applications alike. Reference, audit and refactor skills.

plugins.name: scrumia-practice-tanstack-query
plugins.description: The practices slot — TanStack Query situated for an agent: the queryOptions() factory, query keys, useQuery through testing. Reference skill now; audit and refactor land next.
